correctness.rationale: For alpha>-1 and 0<r<1, Fourier modes of a harmonic Bergman function are orthogonal on the disk and centered circle. Recomputed disk moment as beta B(n+1,alpha+1), trace moment as 2 pi r(1-r^2)^(alpha+1)r^(2n), giving exact sharp diagonal quotient and equality subspaces. The beta recurrence T(n+1)/T(n)=r^2(n+alpha+2)/(n+1) crosses 1 exactly at n+1=s=(alpha+1)r^2/(1-r^2); hence a unique maximizing floor(s) when s is noninteger, or adjacent m-1,m tie when s=m>=1. Source-normalized coefficient divides by alpha+1; at r>0 it is strictly below 2 pi r, yet ratio tends to1 as r->0 by n=0 extremizer. Infinite sequence control is algebraic, not numerical sampling.
